@graph.name: AgenQ
@graph.description: AgenQ is AI training and onboarding software for insurance agencies and brokerages. Staff ask how to do a task and AgenQ shows each step on their screen inside EZLynx or AMS360. In Execution Mode, AgenQ can complete approved tasks, with a person approving the important steps.

@graph.name: Execution Mode: AI That Completes Approved Tasks | AgenQ
@graph.description: AgenQ Execution Mode completes approved tasks inside your insurance software. A person approves the important steps, and every change is recorded.

mainEntity.name: Does AgenQ complete tasks without approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: You decide which steps need a person's approval before they are completed.

mainEntity.name: Can we choose which tasks AgenQ completes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Only the tasks you approve.

mainEntity.name: Can we see what AgenQ changed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every step and change is recorded in audit logs.
